generatorPolicy.quote: No links to sources (this is an opinion piece, not a digest)

reasons.unsourced-series: Retired as part of the automated essay series. The published argument included no external source links. The original generator explicitly required opinion pieces without source links, which made factual claims and broad conclusions difficult to check.
reasons.open-model-claims: The comparisons named no task set or measured results, and treated open-source and open-weight models as interchangeable. The broad claims about model quality and deployment economics were not supported by evidence in the essay.
reasons.prompting-claims: The essay claimed that different prompting approaches produced the same result without a test or source. It also blurred the distinction between asking for structured output and checking that the output satisfies a schema.
reasons.agent-reliability: The 85 percent reliability estimate and universal 99.9 percent product threshold had no task set, measurements or account of the cost of failure. The claimed first-hand agent results had no supporting record in the essay.
